concluding_claim: The study contributes an integrated multi-axis audit of IDS evaluation validity rather than a universally superior architecture.
Selected tree ensembles showed strong discrimination under the processed and stratified CSE-CIC-IDS2018 reference condition.
No universal learner or calibration winner was established in the reference condition.
Chronological development produced higher forward ranking than random development across five registered fixed-recipe realizations.
Frozen operating thresholds transferred poorly to the shared forward target despite improved ranking.
Feature sensitivities and ablation effects varied by split and learner; the controls did not identify one causal shortcut mechanism.
Explanation repeatability did not guarantee local explanation fidelity.
Cross-dataset transfer was directional under the frozen IDS2018/CICIDS2017 bridge and depended on bridge semantics, preprocessing, and direction.
Under fixed-rate prevalence scenarios, predictive value, alert volume, workload, detection yield, and cost preference could diverge.
Computational feasibility was established only for supported paths on the recorded hardware and software stack.
Withheld-family behavior was selective and dependent on family, learner, metric, and threshold.
DOS and AUTH_BRUTE_FORCE were ineligible under the registered LOAO chronology, while the 36-positive Infiltration fold remained descriptive.
The conclusions are conditional on benchmark scope, frozen contracts, finite realizations, target reuse, and heterogeneous artifact availability.
K79 controlled exact available-record identity, not session, endpoint, source-IP, five-tuple, or S4 independence.
The repository supports substantial provenance and selected deterministic checks but not complete end-to-end regeneration of every historical result.
Future work requires independent prospective targets, broader populations and attack-family coverage, stronger independence controls, reproducible environments, and measured operational pipelines.
Multi-axis validity evaluation narrows overclaiming without discarding the information provided by conventional benchmark performance.
